description: This file defines the `BlockNamespace` command class, which represents a command to block signals to a specific namespace within the system. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and setting headers.

classes.name: BlockNamespace
classes.description: A final class representing a command to block signals in a specific namespace. It extends `AbstractNamespaceCommand` and provides static methods for creation and JSON deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of `BlockNamespace` with specified namespace and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of `BlockNamespace` from a JSON object and headers, parsing the JSON to extract the namespace.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new `BlockNamespace` instance with updated headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of `BlockNamespace` for equality purposes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the `BlockNamespace` instance.
